CustomField.description: What the configuration means today: Draft, Returned by CCO, With CCO, Upcoming, Active, Expired or Replaced. Worked out from the status, the last decision and the period.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Draft"), IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, "Rejected"), $Label.Commission_State_Returned, $Label.Commission_State_Draft), IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Pending Approval"), $Label.Commission_State_Pending_Short, IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Superseded"), $Label.Commission_State_Replaced_Short, IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), IF(TODAY() < Start_Date__c, $Label.Commission_State_Upcoming, IF(TODAY() > End_Date__c, IF(ISBLANK(Superseded_By__c), $Label.Commission_State_Expired, $Label.Commission_State_Replaced_Short), $Label.Commission_State_Active)), TEXT(Status__c)))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Worked out from the status and the period: Draft, Returned, With CCO, Upcoming, Active, Expired or Replaced.
CustomField.label: State
